The '''Minashee system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Tadrin sector/Legends|Tadrin subsector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Minashee/Legends|Minashee]].
